name: mcp-trendpulse
description: MCP server to query Google News RSS feeds, analyze keyword search interest over time via Google Trends, and calculate keyword velocity metrics.

tools.name: get_news_by_keyword
tools.description: Search for news using specific keywords.

tools.name: get_news_by_location
tools.description: Retrieve news relevant to a particular location.

tools.name: get_news_by_topic
tools.description: Get news based on a chosen topic.

tools.name: get_top_news
tools.description: Fetch the top news stories from Google News.

tools.name: get_trending_terms
tools.description: Return trending keywords from Google Trends for a specified location.

tools.name: get_trends
tools.description: Pull 5 years of weekly Google Search interest for a keyword to inspect growth/seasonality curves.

tools.name: get_growth
tools.description: Measure how much search interest changed over custom periods (e.g. 3M, 1Y) and compare growth side-by-side.

tools.name: get_ranked_trends
tools.description: Get a ranked list of the highest-volume or fastest-growing keywords on Google Search right now.

tools.name: get_top_trends
tools.description: Discover top trending topics on Google Trends right now without requiring a keyword query.
